name: linsgeek
description: Configure MonsGeek keyboards on Linux, in any browser, with the official web driver.

scripts.build: bun run build:extension && bun run build:host
scripts.build:host: bun run build:host:x64 && bun run build:host:arm64
scripts.check: bun run check:types && bun run check:lint && bun run check:extension
scripts.check:lint: NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.ts --check . '!**/*.{md,mdx}' && NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx oxlint --config oxlint.config.ts .
scripts.check:extension: bun run build:extension && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/extension
scripts.fix: NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx oxlint --config oxlint.config.ts --fix . && NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.ts --write . '!**/*.{md,mdx}'
scripts.sign:xpi: web-ext sign --source-dir dist/extension --artifacts-dir dist --channel unlisted --api-key "${AMO_JWT_ISSUER:?AMO_JWT_ISSUER is required}" --api-secret "${AMO_JWT_SECRET:?AMO_JWT_SECRET is required}"
scripts.release: bun run check && bun run build && rm -f dist/*.xpi && if [ -n "${AMO_JWT_ISSUER:-}" ]; then bun run sign:xpi; else bun run pack:xpi; fi && gzip -kf9 dist/linsgeek-linux-x64 dist/linsgeek-linux-arm64 && gh release create "v$npm_package_version" dist/linsgeek-linux-*.gz dist/*.xpi --repo almeidazs/linsgeek --title "v$npm_package_version" --generate-notes
